licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), lease (ADFZ Business Licensing Regulations (Dec 2011) clause 4.2: licences are not issued without a valid Tenure Document (lease, musataha or similar); clause 13.2(iv): breach of the Tenure Document is a ground to revoke or suspend, CONFIRMED. The regulations date from 2011; current practice may differ); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), lease (no minimum remaining term stated; no 90 day rule found); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf

licence.renewalWindow.value: Apply to renew no later than three months before the end of the current licence term. All fees must be paid before renewal. Renewal is normally for one year.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), renewal window (ADFZ Business Licensing Regulations (Dec 2011) clauses 9.4, 9.5 and 9.7, CONFIRMED; the licensing body was then ADPC and current practice may differ); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: A valid Tenure Document (lease) is required for a licence, and other documents are required under ADPC instruments. The tenant must keep insurance throughout the lease term. Nothing official found on the establishment card renewing together.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), renews together (ADFZ Business Licensing Regulations clauses 4.2 and 9.6; KEZAD Standard Lease Terms 2026; CONFIRMED); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf ; https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/09/KEZAD-Group-Standard-Terms-and-Conditions-for-Lease-2026.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: No grace period or day threshold found. A licence may be revoked or suspended by written notice if a renewal fee, late fee or fine is unpaid. Suspension lasts for a period the authority specifies or until conditions are met. No automatic deregistration timing found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), late renewal (ADFZ Business Licensing Regulations clauses 13.2(iii) and 13.3, CONFIRMED); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), late renewal (no grace period found); https://www.kezadgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/23/2026/04/ADFZ-Business-Licensing-Regulations_Dec2011.pdf
